name: nasbench201_cifar10_full_suite
description: Matched-budget comparison of seven search policies on NATS-Bench TSS (NAS-Bench-201) CIFAR-10: random, regularized evolution, REINFORCE, GP-UCB Bayesian optimization, ArchAI predictor-guided, ArchAI-V1 generator-guided, and multi-objective (accuracy vs. parameters) Pareto evolution, plus four ablations. Selection uses cifar10-valid validation accuracy only; cifar10 test accuracy of the selected cell is reported separately. Learned models are fitted online on in-budget observations only. Hyperparameters were fixed before any run and not tuned.
